title: Best for any venturing out on their own the 1st time!!
text:
Best for any venturing out on their own the 1st time!!. This is a 3 pack set of cutting boards sold for a price point under $15. This provides different options and will be quite useful for some. However, it’s not the best option for myself.

•Sizing is smaller then, bigger. The largest cutting board is just a bit bigger than a standard sheet of paper. Great for use in a boat galley, RV, dorm,1st time apartment, etc.. Bc, these have easy storage capability and on the smaller board- there is a gutter for any liquid runoff and debris.. handle on largest board has Hollow center and could be used to hang! These are some nice features and creature comforts to have but, its not conducive to my needs in my kitchen cooking for a family of 6.

• Smooth, round edges and low height make it difficult to pick up the smaller 2 boards as, they have no handle. I have to slide board to the edge of counter to get a grip underneath- depending on what I’m cutting it can be a bit tricky! Backside of board is smooth without rubber “stoppers” letting this slide around on counter. Not a good feature when trying to cut! I have to Tetris some counter items to hold cutting board still-

•2 wks. of using, I’m seeing knick's in the surface.. How?!! I’ve been extra cautious and used only a paring knife. I’m actually replacing a similar style cutting board I’ve had over a decade.. But as much as I need this, I’m worried this may not have the longevity to go the distance..?!

•Cleaning is KEY! be sure to do it right. Personally, I cut all meat on stone block.. and this keeps yuck and bacteria from sinking into wood grain or, a Knick or, cut on a plastic board. Keeping raw meat from Cross contamination with other food sources- use separate board for meat and always clean properly.

This is a great economical set of boards and good for light cooking or, extra cutting surfaces for food prep. It isn’t size I need for a larger family on daily basis- But, it could be a good starting board for those beginning to venture out in their own kitchen.. or, use in smaller places as listed above.

I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!
